verdict.rationale: Grafana documents its own agent-facing interfaces: a hosted Cloud MCP Server and an open-source MCP Server for connecting AI agents, plus a published OpenAPI spec. Separately, its core product queries metrics, logs, and traces, and Loki (LogQL) and Mimir provide query capabilities. However, no evidence shows which metrics, logs, or traces query operations the MCP server or API actually exposes to an external agent, so coverage of the full story is only implied. Missing for 10: documentation of MCP/API tools for querying metrics, logs, and traces; evidence of an agent-driven production debugging workflow; independent or hands-on corroboration of agent querying.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: Connect AI agents to Grafana through the fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or the self-managed open source MCP Server.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana
enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored
LogQL is Grafana Loki's query language.
Grafana Mimir enables users to ingest Prometheus or OpenTelemetry metrics, run queries
